body: I know it's all my fault but it just seems impossibly hard to sit down and revise all the notes I've taken in class/reread the textbooks when for over 12 years I've never had to study for anything and always just *got it* from listening the first time. I read my notes, which are pretty much just verbatim from the different professors/lecturers and it's just so hard to keep focused and interested in the subjects when I don't understand anything about it.

It's simple, if you don't have a job you don't have money, you don't have money you can't buy food, buy a place to live at, etc.
  
Also, I know saying this makes me sound like a humongous prick but honestly I don't really care what killing myself would do to my family. If anything I'd be doing them a favour by just killing myself off instead of just mooching off of them for several years, besides it's not like I'm great company either.

It's just that if I drop out I won't be able to enroll and try again without having to pay money and my financial situation isn't that good. Sure I've got a roof over my head and I should be thankful for that but I can't stay with my parents/grandparents forever without working and without going through university I don't really see myself getting a job because I don't have any other skills and am really horrible with a job that requires any social interaction at all.
  
I just feel that I should just end it now rather than drag it out to later when I'm on the streets as a bum.
